answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake in a reputation ledger before it can transact. Each transaction carries a fee scaled by the agent's graph position: a lone vertex trading only with itself pays more than one embedded in a real web of counterparties. A sybil army then faces linear cost growth - every fake identity must lock real capital - while honest agents split fees across their long voyage of trades. If abuse is detected, stakes are slashed, so an attacker hiding in a nebula of fakes loses the whole deposit pool. Raise the cost of copies, not the height of gates.
